scientific_integrity: Proof provided analytically, numerical tests are supplementary; source dates are earliest public preprint records; no independent review or historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Ball-only theorem for positive radii, dimensions at least two, and exponential quadratic weights with nonnegative parameters or admissible positive mixtures. Universal (not fixed-parameter) sharpness; no conclusion for all convex bodies; unindexed historical overlap remains possible.
title: Origin-free sharp quantitative weighted-perimeter monotonicity for nested Euclidean balls
